title: A Method for Ovarian Follicle Encapsulation and Culture in a Proteolytically Degradable 3 Dimensional System
protocol: Transfer freshly dissected ovaries from 16 day old mouse into a new 35 mm Petri dish with 1-2 mL MM containing 0.1% Collagenase and 0.1% DNase.
Incubate for 15 minutes inside an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Perform several washing steps in DM to remove collagenase.
Transfer to a 35 mm Petri dish with fresh DM.
Isolate follicles from the ovary by gently flicking (or cutting) follicles away from the whole ovary using two 28 5/8 gauge needles attached to disposable syringes.
Remove as much stroma as possible without damaging the integrity of follicle.
Dissect out 20-40 secondary follicles per ovary.
Add 1 mL MM to the central well of a 60 mm IVF Petri dish.
Add 3 mL MM to the outer ring of the same Petri dish.
Transfer intact follicles with a pipette to the outer ring for rinsing.
Selectively transfer healthy follicles into the central well.
Store the IVF dish in the incubator.
Prepare thrombin solution by adding 1 mL of 50 IU/mL thrombin in TBS with 40 mM CaCl2 to the middle well of the Petri dish.
Thaw fibrinogen stock (50 mg/mL in TBS) on ice and keep it cool until ready for use.
Bring fibrinogen to room temperature right before preparing the solution.
Mix 1x PBS, 0.5% alginate in PBS solution, and 50 mg/mL fibrinogen solution at a ratio of 2:1:1 in a microcentrifuge tube.
Avoid introducing bubbles into the mixture while mixing.
Gently vortex and spin down the mixture to prepare the fibrinogen/alginate solution.
The prepared solution should appear slightly cloudy.
Place two droplets of fibrinogen/alginate solution in the outer ring of an IVF dish: a 90 μL droplet for encapsulation and a 10 μL droplet for washing.
Turn off the heating stage on the dissecting microscope to decrease evaporation.
Transfer 10-15 follicles into the 10 μL droplet with less than 5 μL of culture media using a 200 μm micropipette tip.
Quickly mix the follicles in the 10 μL droplet.
Transfer all the follicles into the 90 μL droplet with less than 5 μL of solution from the first drop.
Mix the follicles thoroughly in the 90 μL droplet.
Aspirate one follicle and 5 μL of fibrinogen/alginate solution using a 10 μL pipette tip.
Release the aspirated mixture into the thrombin/Ca2+ solution in the IVF dish.
Repeat this process until all the follicles are encapsulated.
Cross-link the beads for 5-7 minutes in the thrombin/Ca2+ solution.
Transfer the beads into a Petri dish containing MM, starting with the darker beads first.
Incubate the dish for 15-30 minutes in the incubator to rinse off the remaining thrombin.
Transfer the beads into a 96 well culture plate containing 100 μL of follicle growth media.
Image the beads immediately after transfer.
Prepare the fibrinogen/alginate solution by mixing 0.5% alginate solution with 50 mg/mL fibrinogen solution at a 1:1 ratio.
Pipette 7.5 μL drops of the fibrinogen/alginate mixture onto a parafilm coated glass slide with 3 mm spacers.
Transfer 1 follicle into each drop with minimal media.
Add 7.5 μL of thrombin/Ca2+ solution to each drop.
Cover the gels with a second parafilm coated glass slide.
Place the slides upside down in a 100 mm Petri dish and transfer to an incubator for 5 minutes.
Transfer the beads into a Petri dish containing MM.
Transfer the beads into a culture well as previously described.
Gently separate beads that stick together with forceps if necessary.
Image the cultured follicles using a light microscope every 2 days.
Measure the follicle diameter with ImageJ software every 2 days.
Replace half of the growth media (50 μL) with fresh, pre-equilibrated growth media every 2 days.
After 8 days of culture, remove growth media from wells containing the beads.
Add 100 mL of 10 IU/mL alginate lyase in αMEM to each well.
Leave plate in incubator for 25-30 minutes.
Remove follicles from dissolved beads with a blunt end tip.
Transfer follicles to the outer ring of an IVF dish containing DM.
Wash follicles by transferring them to the center well, also containing DM.
Transfer follicles to the outer ring of an IVF dish containing maturation media.
Transfer follicles to the inner ring of an IVF dish containing maturation media.
Incubate in CO2 incubator for 15-16 hours.
Examine follicles for cumulus cells expansion.
Add hyaluronidase solution to final concentration 0.1 mg/mL.
Incubate in incubator for 2-3 minutes.
Use a 75 mm micropipette tip to shear the cumulus cells from the oocyte by pipetting up and down several times.
Determine maturation stage of the oocyte under light or dissecting microscope.
Isolate follicles at the secondary stage of development (150-180 μm diameter).
Expand isolated follicles to 400 μm in FA-IPN gels.
Culture follicles with hCG stimulation for cumulus cell expansion and meiosis resumption.
Remove aprotinin from culture medium after initial use if used at 0.01 TIU/mL concentration.
Use a high concentration of aprotinin (0.1 TIU/mL) to inhibit fibrin degradation significantly.
Prevent follicle expansion by maintaining high matrix stiffness due to aprotinin presence.
Observe somatic cell invasion into the matrix in cultures with high aprotinin concentrations.
Pipette two drops of fibrinogen-alginate solution into the dish.
Transfer 3-5 follicles to a rinsing drop.
Rinse and remove media from follicles.
Transfer rinsed follicles to the encapsulation drop.
Aspirate each follicle with 5 μL fibrinogen-alginate solution using a 10 μL pipette tip.
Expel aspirated follicles into thrombin/calcium solution.
